title: MURDLE — The Retail Showcase Incident
subtitle: 4 suspects, 4 tools, 4 locations
storyHtml:
A client retail showcase failed during a Dynavics demonstration, leaving a critical LS Central configuration in the wrong state. The evidence points to one consultant, one tool, and one workspace.

Each consultant had one tool in one location. Trace the Business Central and LS Central activity to resolve the incident.

clues.text: Ian Storer used the Data Migration Package in the Client Launch Room.
Dan Jones used the Integration Test Device in the Support Hub.
Adam Sellers was moving the LS Central POS Terminal in the Retail Experience Lab.
Kieran Coles filed the Support Escalation Note from the Partner Demo Suite.
The disrupted retail showcase was in the Retail Experience Lab.
